name: SmartProductSEO Internal Link Opportunities
author: jolizzie

sections.description:
SmartProductSEO Internal Link Opportunities helps WordPress site owners discover useful internal-link opportunities across their own published content.

The plugin is designed for different niches and site types. It can analyze public posts, pages, WooCommerce products when available, and other public custom post types. Its local matching engine uses titles, body content, excerpts, categories, tags, taxonomies, and existing internal links to identify related content.

Features include:

  • Scan published site content for contextual internal-link relationships.
  • Find pages with very few outgoing internal links.
  • Find orphaned content with no detected incoming internal links.
  • Find links to a chosen page.
  • Find links from a chosen page.
  • Generate sentence and short paragraph suggestions locally.
  • Use varied sentence structures and contextual anchor text.
  • Show a relevance score for suggested relationships.
  • Preview paragraph suggestions before insertion.
  • Insert only after explicit user approval.
  • Dismiss unwanted source/destination pairs.
  • Track suggestions inserted through the plugin.
  • Analyze public custom post types for broad niche compatibility.
  • No external AI API and no content sent to an external service.
  • No 301 redirect scanning. The plugin focuses on contextual internal linking.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate SmartProductSEO Internal Link Opportunities.
  3. Open SmartProductSEO Internal Link Opportunities in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Run a website scan and review the suggested internal-link opportunities.
sections.faq:
Does SmartProductSEO Internal Link Opportunities work only with WooCommerce?

No. It is designed for general WordPress sites and can analyze posts, pages, WooCommerce products when available, and other public custom post types.

Does it use an external AI service?

No. SmartProductSEO Internal Link Opportunities performs matching and suggestion construction locally inside WordPress.

Does it automatically change my content during a scan?

No. Scanning never inserts links. A user with permission to edit the source content must explicitly choose to insert a sentence or paragraph suggestion.

Does it scan 301 redirects?

No. SmartProductSEO Internal Link Opportunities is intentionally focused on contextual internal-link opportunities and does not perform redirect scanning.

1.3.7

  • Align translation text domain with the WordPress.org plugin slug. No changes to scanning, link insertion, settings, or stored data.

1.3.6

  • Removed the deprecated taxonomy argument from term_description() for current WordPress compatibility.

1.3.5

  • Renamed the plugin to SmartProductSEO Internal Link Opportunities for a more distinctive WordPress.org directory identity.
  • Updated the plugin product link to https://smartproductseo.com/product/internal-link-opportunities/.

1.3.4

  • Prepared plugin metadata and readme information for WordPress.org submission.
  • Confirmed local contextual internal-link scanning and suggestion workflow.

1.2.6

  • Added a prominent pink Back to Dashboard button at the top of SmartProductSEO Internal Link Opportunities subpages for faster navigation.

1.2.4

  • Rewrote the Link Opportunities instructions to explain editing, refreshing, and inserting suggested sentences and paragraphs.

1.2.3

  • Added pencil editors for both sentence and paragraph suggestions before insertion.
  • Edited wording stays in the selected opportunity row and only that edited sentence or paragraph is inserted when its Add button is clicked.
  • Internal destination links are preserved and verified before saving.

1.2.2

  • Removed the temporary insertion diagnostic panel from Link Opportunities now that product insertion is verified and working correctly.
  • Removed the diagnostic response payload and diagnostic-only admin styling/JavaScript.
  • Kept the v1.2.1 one-click/one-insertion behavior unchanged.

1.2.1

  • Fixed Add Sentence/Add Paragraph so one click inserts only the suggestion from the clicked opportunity row.
  • Removed the v1.2.0 legacy bulk-migration behavior that could append multiple older fallback suggestions at once.
  • Legacy fallback records are now retired without copying them into the Product Short Description.
  • Product insertions remain stored only at the end of the real Product Short Description.

1.2.0

  • Rebuilt WooCommerce insertion to use the real Product Short Description (post_excerpt) as the single source of truth.
  • Add Sentence and Add Paragraph now append exactly one approved insertion at the absolute end of the Product Short Description.
  • Removed the separate WooCommerce frontend fallback renderer and visible-insertion meta path.
  • Legacy 1.1.x fallback records are migrated into the editable Product Short Description and their exact duplicate copies are removed from product content where possible.
  • Product insertions are now visible and manually editable directly in the Product Short Description editor.

1.1.9

  • Added end-to-end insertion diagnostics for source ID, content field, database update result, saved marker/link verification, WooCommerce insertion metadata, and exact placement.
  • Keeps the opportunity row visible after insertion so the saved-content diagnostic can be reviewed immediately.

1.1.8

  • Rebuilt product insertion around persistent approved insertion records plus the standard WooCommerce product-summary render path.
  • Sentence and paragraph insertions are still written into real post content and are now also guaranteed a visible product-page location when themes do not render that content field.
  • Added end-to-end verification of both saved post content and the visible product insertion record.

1.1.7

  • Rebuilt sentence and paragraph insertion to write into the real source content at a contextual paragraph and verify the saved internal link.
  • WooCommerce products also receive a verified copy in the real short-description field for broad theme compatibility.
  • Added an Edit Page shortcut beside View Page for direct verification.

1.1.6

  • Fixed product sentence and paragraph insertion so approved links are saved in real product content and reliably shown on the live WooCommerce product page.

1.1.4

  • Real front-end insertion fix for WooCommerce products whose themes do not display the normal long-description content.
  • Add Sentence and Add Paragraph still save the approved text into post_content, and now also keep a verified product-page fallback copy.
  • The fallback renders approved insertions on the live single-product page only when the theme did not already render the saved SmartProductSEO Internal Link Opportunities block, preventing normal duplicate output.
  • Keeps database-write verification and WooCommerce cache clearing.

1.1.3

  • Fixed sentence and paragraph insertion so approved suggestions are saved as real WordPress paragraph blocks.
  • Verifies the database write before reporting insertion success.
  • Clears relevant post/WooCommerce caches after insertion so saved content is available immediately.

1.1.2

  • Added a View Page button to every Link Opportunity row so users can open the source page and review inserted sentences or paragraphs on the live site.

1.0.8

  • Fixed Change Sentence so every product refresh advances to a different sentence beginning.
  • Product openers now rotate independently from sentence endings, preventing the same opening clause from repeating on consecutive clicks.
  • Keeps more than 100 distinct product sentence beginnings available before an opener is reused.

1.0.7

  • Added 120 unique product-suggestion opening phrases so Change Sentence does not repeat the same beginning during normal refresh rotation.
  • Refresh rotation now moves through unique opening phrases before reusing an opener.

1.0.3

  • Expanded product-link suggestion wording to more than 100 deterministic sentence variations to prevent repetitive template-like recommendations.
  • Improved sentence variation distribution across similar source/destination pairs.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
